observations: Photo 0: Black DSLR body held in hand, 'Canon' logo visible on front, partial model text '800' visible on top right of body, kit lens marked 'EF-S 18-55mm' with lens cap on.

Photo 1: Rear view of the same camera, flip-out LCD screen open but screen content not visible/lit, viewfinder visible, a small black antenna-like accessory (possibly a wifi/remote dongle) clipped to the hot-shoe, background shows other cameras and boxes (shop display).
Photo 2: Front view again, clearer text 'Canon EOS 800' visible on top plate, lens cap on, body shows normal wear consistent with used condition, no visible cracks or major damage.
No shot of the camera powered on, no shutter count/menu screen, no battery or charger shown, no test photo from the camera.

claims.claim: Neat UK used Canon 800D with 18-55mm lens
claims.evidence: Photos show cosmetic condition appears clean with no visible scratches or cracks, but 'UK used' origin and overall 'neat' claim cannot be confirmed from photos alone; no proof of import history or internal condition.
Photo 0 and photo 2 show a lens mounted on the body marked 'EF-S 18-55mm'.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or have sensor/shutter faults
risks.proof: A photo or short video of the camera powered on showing the rear screen with a live image or menu, plus shutter count if accessible.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed working (worst case, as if non-functional)

risks.risk: Lens glass could be scratched, fungused, or have focus/zoom issues
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens with the cap off, front and rear elements visible.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens condition unknown/worst case (possible defect)

risks.risk: LCD screen may not display properly despite being physically intact
risks.proof: A photo/video of the screen turned on showing a live view or menu.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, strap, memory card) could add extra cost for buyer
risks.proof: A photo of the full kit laid out including battery, charger, and any included accessories.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body+lens only, no accessories included

risks.risk: The small antenna-like attachment in photo 1 is unexplained and could indicate a modified or non-standard setup
risks.proof: A clear photo or explanation of what this accessory is and whether it affects the camera's normal operation.
risks.if_unproven: treated as unknown accessory, not counted toward value

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on, showing the screen live and the shutter firing.
Close-up of the lens with cap removed, front and rear elements.
Photo of included accessories (battery, charger, memory card, strap).
Photo of the shutter count from the camera's menu if possible.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Canon EOS 800D DSLR with an 18-55mm kit lens from the top-plate text in two photos, but no functional proof (power-on, screen, lens glass) is shown, so it must be priced at worst case against comparable used Canon DSLR kits in the same market.
